observations: Black sewing machine with gold and yellow decorative patterns on the head and base.
Brand name 'MAY LENAPHEAL' is printed on the front of the machine.
The machine is mounted on a wooden base.
The needle plate and the upper part of the machine are visible.
The machine appears to be in good cosmetic condition.

claims.evidence: The brand name 'MAY LENAPHEAL' is not a Japanese brand; it is a Nigerian business name.
There is no photo of the machine powered on to demonstrate the motor function.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not stitch or may have a broken needle.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation with a piece of fabric being sewn.

risks.risk: The motor may be noisy or have insufficient power.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running at high speed.

risks.risk: The needle may be bent or the needle plate may be damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the needle and the needle plate.

proof_requests: Video of the sewing machine powered on and stitching fabric.
Close-up photo of the needle and the needle plate.
Photo of the underside of the machine to check the needle bar and belt condition.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
